messages:
Maya: Hi everyone, I'm Maya, just joined as SRE. New company MacBook Air showed up and MDM enrollment completed, but FileVault prompt says 'Action required: Enable FileVault' and when I click it, it asks for an administrative account. I don't have admin creds. Need to install Homebrew and our lightweight observability agent. Who should I ask? cc @it-helpdesk

it-helpdesk: Welcome, Maya! :tada: We restrict permanent admin, but we can provide a time-limited sudo uplift. Please confirm your availability for a remote session and whether you're on a wired connection or Wi-Fi. Also what macOS build do you have (Apple Silicon or Intel)?

Maya: Thanks! I'm on M2 (macOS 13.6.4). I can do a remote session around 11am PT. Wired via docking station.

Riley: Hey @Maya, congrats! For Homebrew you can use our managed install if you don't get admin. But for FileVault enabling we need to escrow the recovery key into Jamf/MDM. We can push the enable via our enrollment script but it usually requires sudo to complete the first unlock. If you can join a screen share, we can temporarily elevate and set FileVault to enabled and confirm the recovery key is stored.

SecurityOps: Quick note from Sec: confirm you have a personal iCloud FileVault key disabled (company policy disallows iCloud escrow). We'll verify the recovery key is in our MDM (never to user iCloud). Also for developer tools, we only allow Homebrew installs under /opt/homebrew for Apple Silicon to avoid touching /usr/local.

it-helpdesk: Adding ticket IT-4882 for the temporary uplift and FileVault escrow. Remote session scheduled at 11:00 PT. We'll grant a 2-hour admin token via our agent. Please keep the laptop plugged in and joined to corporate Wi-Fi or VPN so MDM contact works.

Maya: Session started. it-helpdesk: please proceed.

it-helpdesk: During the session we performed these steps:
- Confirmed macOS build 13.6.4 (M2)
- Enabled Secure Boot settings default via startup security utility (no change needed)
- Ran `sudo fdesetup enable -defer` to kick off FileVault enablement and then validated escrowed key in Jamf console
- Applied a 2-hour admin token to Maya's account for installing Homebrew and the observability agent

Maya: I installed Homebrew and the agent, ran `brew install --cask docker` (needed to install Docker Desktop), and verified the agent is reporting. FileVault shows 'Encryption in Progress'. Intune/Jamf shows recovery key present.

DevOncall: For Docker Desktop, note that Apple Silicon users need the new Docker build; if you hit kernel module errors, ensure you use the Desktop stable channel. Also post-encryption you might need to reauthorize kernel extensions if prompted.

Maya: All good now. Encryption finished overnight and the laptop marked compliant in MDM. Big thanks everyone for the quick uplift and guidance! :raised_hands:

Riley: Welcome to the team again! If you want, we can add you to the dev images program so you get a preconfigured VM for heavier builds without needing local resources. Ping me in DMs.

Maya: Will do. Also my GitHub handle is mayarun, Slack timezone PT. Thanks!
